Feedback welcome: Beta availability of Nginx performance monitoring @Ruxit

When I make reports I grab a copy and put it on my PC, make my changes, then upload the changes to a server. When I test on the PC I want to display the report filename at the bottom of the report, but in production, on the server, I don't want to do that. Here's the formula to display the report filename only when the report runs on the C: drive.

Make a formula called "ReportName". Put in this code: 

numbervar maxlen;
maxlen:=50; // Display only 50 right characters.
if (Instr(Filename,'file:/C:')>0) then // If on PC, display filename.
iif (len(Filename)>maxlen , Right(Filename, maxlen), Filename); // Display nothing if report run on server.
else
''

Now drag the formula to the report footer, resize the text box and set the font you want. Now you have the report name when you need it, and it won't appear when the report is run on the server. If your report on your PC is on a D: drive, for example, change this code: file:/C: to file:/D:.
